#!/bin/bash
# P26 at main 36c33fe: build xl from six pieces, ingest, verify under /usr/bin/time -l.
set -u
L=$1; R=$L/p26; M=/Users/zahidaramai/Local_Sites/seis-mdio-zarr; mkdir -p $R; cd $M
git -C $M log --oneline -1
PYTHONPATH=$M .venv/bin/python - $R <<'PY'
import sys, hashlib, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from tests.fixtures.generators.poststack3d import make_poststack3d
r = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = r / "xl.sgy"
with out.open("wb") as f:
    for k in range(6):
        piece = make_poststack3d(r / f"piece{k}.sgy", n_inline=300, n_crossline=630, n_samples=1000, inline_start=100 + 300 * k).path
        with piece.open("rb") as p:
            head = p.read(3600)
            if k == 0: f.write(head)
            shutil.copyfileobj(p, f, 1 << 24)
        piece.unlink()
        print("piece", k, "done", flush=True)
h = hashlib.sha256()
with out.open("rb") as f:
    for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 24), b""): h.update(b)
print("xl", out.stat().st_size, h.hexdigest(), flush=True)
PY
/usr/bin/time -l .venv/bin/sdip ingest $R/xl.sgy $R/xl.mdio > $R/xl.ingest.out 2> $R/xl.ingest.time
echo "ingest exit $? $(grep -E 'maximum resident' $R/xl.ingest.time) $(grep -E ' real ' $R/xl.ingest.time)"
/usr/bin/time -l .venv/bin/sdip verify --json --skip-portability --envelope-gib 0 $R/xl.sgy $R/xl.mdio > $R/xl.verify.json 2> $R/xl.verify.time
echo "verify exit $? $(grep -E 'maximum resident' $R/xl.verify.time) $(grep -E ' real ' $R/xl.verify.time)"
